name: Mobile Telecommunications Company Saudi Arabia (Zain KSA)

audit.method: Archived source PDFs under data/raw/SA/<symbol>/documents (SHA-256 re-computed and equal to data/raw/archive-index.json for all 26 archived files). Digital pages: text layer read and the printed figure located. Scanned pages (stc, Zain, Elm primary statements): pages rendered to PNG with PyMuPDF and read by eye, line by line, both columns. Findings are proven with page and line item; 'verified_correct' is claimed only where the printed page was read. Internal arithmetic (subtotals, reconciliations) used only as a secondary check, never as proof. Offline; no AWS, no Supabase, no data/raw edits.
tools_added_on_branch: docs/audits/saudi-independent/batch1-C-provenance-scan.json (machine scan of every fact vs its cited page)

status_vocabulary.verified_correct: printed page read; value, sign, period column, scale and unit match
status_vocabulary.defective: proven wrong or mislabelled against the printed page
status_vocabulary.unverified: source not available/archived or not readable here; nothing is claimed
status_vocabulary.verified_correct_with_caveat: value correct as printed but label/semantics need a note (no value change required)
status_vocabulary.pending (source status): document is not archived or not present locally, so the source cannot be re-read; resumable once archived

audit.rejected_facts_note: No manifest of these symbols contains 'excluded_facts'/rejected records on telecom-95pct, and data/financial.sqlite3 in the repo has zero rows for them. A production rejected-fact registry (AWS DB) was out of bounds for this audit -> rejected facts: unverified.
audit.why_authoritative: origin/codex/telecom-95pct is the newest lineage of the telecom manifests. origin/claude/telecom-shared-gap-closers (a8245ac) forks at 3980d36 and carries OLDER copies of stc-2025-fy.json, stc-2025-segments-financial-notes.json, stc-2025-company-profile.json and zain-ksa-2025-notes-segments.json (fewer facts); its mobily-2025-fy.json, zain-ksa-2025-fy.json and go-telecom-2021-2025-fy-history.json are byte-identical to the audited ones. It additionally holds the raw Saudi Exchange market archives (data/raw/SA/70x0/market) and *-market-prices-2026-09-23.json manifests that are NOT on telecom-95pct; those raw archives were read via 'git show' (read-only) to audit the price manifests. origin/claude/data-tech-1 (a10e790) elm-2025-fy.json is byte-identical to the audited Elm manifest. origin/claude/data-telecom-1 (f778594) holds the first, shorter stc/Zain FY2025 manifests (superseded).

findings.line_item: Note 40 Segment reporting: 'Mobile Telecommunications Company' column / row before eliminations

correct_value.statement: These are the legal-entity segment 'Mobile Telecommunications Company' before eliminations. Consolidated: total assets 28,753,303 (after eliminations (29,920,980)), total liabilities 17,877,352, D&A 2,160,661 (note 40 total column; P&L p9)

findings.evidence: PDF p70: 'Assets: Mobile Telecommunications Company 57,603,795 | Tamam Finance Company 1,030,079 | Others 40,409 | Eliminations / adjustments (29,920,980) | Total assets 28,753,303'. PDF p69: 'Depreciation and amortization (2,153,794) | (6,577) | (290) | (2,160,661)'. Tagging the entity column scope='consolidated' lets any consumer that reads scope see assets of 57.6bn next to the audited 28.75bn.
findings.fix: Set scope='segment' with dimensions {'segment': 'Mobile Telecommunications Company'} (the sibling facts already use that pattern for Consumer/Business/Wholesale revenue).

findings.line_item: 26-2: 'revenue has been recognized from their operation within KSA except for the international roaming and interconnect which account 14.97% (2024: 15.54%)'

published_value.label: Revenue from operations within KSA excluding international roaming and interconnect

correct_value.printed: only the percentage 14.97%; no SAR amount is printed

findings.evidence: 9,338,850 occurs nowhere in the 71-page PDF (text and scanned statement pages checked: grep + visual p8-p12). It is a derived number carried with six-digit precision although the document supports only a 14.97% share. The percentage itself is not published as a fact.
findings.fix: Delete the derived fact (or mark metadata.derivation='total revenue x (1 - 14.97%)' and publish the printed 14.97% as the primary fact).

findings.line_item: 'No single customers contributed 10% or more to the Group's revenues.'

correct_value.statement: qualitative: no customer reaches 10% (a bound, not a value of zero)

findings.evidence: A sentence is stored as the number 0 (unit 'pure'); downstream a 0% concentration is wrong - the largest customer is 'below 10%', unknown. stc stores the opposite case (government 11.298bn) as a number, so the metric means different things per issuer.
findings.fix: Store as a boolean/qualitative disclosure or as {'value': '0.10', 'qualifier': 'less_than'}.

correct_value.cash_amount: about SAR 449,364,588 (0.50 x 898,729,175 shares; total cash distributed as in cash-flow 'Dividend paid' 451,855 thousand in 2025 and 448,115 in 2024)

findings.evidence: Across all manifests in data/imports the other 22 corporate actions (stc 2,750,000,000 per quarter; Mobily 924,000,000; GO 10,199,970) store the TOTAL cash in cash_amount. Zain's four rows are the only ones where cash_amount equals dividend_per_share, i.e. a per-share amount in a total field - an understatement of about 898,729,175x (the share count) if summed.
findings.fix: Set cash_amount = total (DPS x shares) and keep dividend_per_share in details.

correct_value.where: FY2022/FY2023: AR2023 PDF p17 'Operational & Financial Performance 2023|2022'; FY2021: AR2021 PDF p23 and AR2022 PDF p20 (NOT in AR2023); no page 46/48 holds them

findings.evidence: AR2023 p17: Revenue (USD m) 2,634 | 2,421; EBITDA 794 | 842; Net Profit 338 | 147. AR2021 p23: 2021 revenue 2,111, EBITDA 836, net profit 57. FY2022 as first reported (AR2022 p20) was 2,427 / 828 / 133 - the manifest correctly uses the later restated 2,421/842/147 as its notes state. The facts are USD amounts of a SAR-reporting issuer under metric names revenue/ebitda/net_income: with no SAR annual statements for FY2021-FY2023 in the repo, a consumer asking for 7030 FY2023 revenue gets 2,634 (USD m).
findings.fix: Cite AR2021 p23 for 2021 and AR2023 p17 for 2022-2023; add the archive entry for this manifest; publish SAR figures from Zain KSA's own audited statements or dimension the facts as currency basis USD.

findings.evidence: AR2021 p23 text: 'increase of 5G population coverage from 54% to 63%' but the Network KPI donut on the same page shows '62%'. Published 63% follows the text. 2022 (63%, p20 donut) verified.
findings.fix: None required; keep a note that the issuer's own page conflicts.

findings.evidence: Saudi Exchange announcements (anId=93064 etc.) are not archived. Arithmetic reconciliation only (NOT proof): FY2025 quarters 10,983 / 1,313 / 604 vs audited FY2025 10,983,264 / 1,312,791 / 603,873; FY2024 10,364 / 1,200 / 596 vs 10,365,461 / 1,199,106 / 596,369. By construction Q4 = FY less 9M so annual totals reconcile regardless; Q1-Q3 individual values cannot be verified. FY2023: no SAR annual in the repo to reconcile (USD 2,634 m x 3.75 = 9,877 vs quarter sum 9,882).
findings.fix: Archive the quarterly announcements' PDFs/pages; the manifest already lists exact URLs.
